title: 'Three Times Their Speed': Donald Trump Details US Air Force Pilots' 'Very Strange' UFO Encounters
description: Donald Trump revisits an F-22 UFO claim on 60 Minutes, describing a round object travelling at three times the jet's speed, despite earlier accounts

title: Area 51 Secrets? Trump Responds to Claims of Hidden UFO Programme Even Presidents Don't Know About
description: Donald Trump said he had neither heard of nor seen evidence for an alleged secret government UFO programme, while acknowledging unusual accounts from military pilots.

title: 'They've told me things': Trump on UFO encounters reported by Air Force pilots
description: Donald Trump recalls unusual UFO encounters reported by Air Force pilots, including an object allegedly flying three times faster than an F-22 jet.

title: Trump on UFO sightings: Air Force pilots have told me 'very strange' things
description: In a sitdown with 60 Minutes, President Donald Trump weighed in on UFOs and said that Air Force pilots have "told me things that are very strange".

title: Alien hunter claims Trump could unveil UFO proof to distract from midterm defeat
description: A UFO filmmaker claims Donald Trump could pull off the ultimate political stunt by unveiling a living extraterrestrial to distract from a brutal midterm election defeat.
